text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency SLO burn detected on /v1/generate (route: model-serving-usw2). p99=2300ms over 5m, threshold=2000ms. PagerDuty PD-12345 fired. https://alerts.internal/PD-12345

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-12345 triggered — paging on-call for eng-oncall. Escalation policy: primary -> alex.

alex: ack PD-12345. i'm oncall, taking this. :wave:

priya: looking at infra now. seeing batcher-sidecar queue depth up x6 on infer-01, cpu 90%, gpu-mem 98% on gpu-node-7. no 5xx spikes in front proxy.

jamie: quick question — is this hotkeyed traffic or broad?

priya: looks broad across many keys; distribution skewed but not single hotkey. request size tail increased (avg tokens up).

alex: are fallbacks enabled for this route? can we route some % to a smaller model to shave latency?

jamie: yes, we have redwood-medium as a compatible variant. I can start a gradual switch.

alex: initiating 30% rollout to redwood-medium now. command: 
```
route-manager rollout --route /v1/generate --to redwood-medium --pct 30
```

nora: support check — any customer-facing errors? I don't see 5xx or API errors in Sentry, just slow responses reported in a few support tickets.

sam: product informed; prepping status draft. likely customer impact = elevated latency for generation in US-WEST.

priya: mitigation actions: restarting batcher-sidecar on infer-01 (hot path), clearing KV prefix for stale shards, and requesting +2 burst GPUs in us-west-2.

priya: KV eviction command:
```
curl -X POST https://kv.internal/evict -d '{"prefix":"/kvcache/model/redwood-large/hot"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEVOPS'
```

jamie: scaling request sent to autoscaler team, submitted ticket for burst capacity.

alex: rollout at 30% -> observing p99 down to 1.7s (from 2.3s). continuing.

priya: restarted batcher-sidecar on infer-01 -> queue depth back to normal, cpu 45%. p99 now 1.1s across the fleet.

nora: noted reduced ticket chatter. no new high-priority support issues.

sam: drafting status page: "Degraded latency in US-WEST affecting generation endpoints. Traffic partially routed to a fallback model; mitigations in progress." will post after final confirmation.

alex: monitoring for 10m window. if p99 stays < 2000ms we can close.

incident-bot: Alert: p99 latency back within SLO (1.05s) for 10m on /v1/generate. PD-12345 updated.

alex: confirmed stable. closing PD-12345. thanks team. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: PD-12345 resolved by alex. Summary: burst in request size caused batcher-sidecar saturation + GPU memory pressure; mitigations: batcher restart, KV eviction, 30% traffic routed to redwood-medium during recovery, requested burst GPUs.

sam: follow-up: schedule short retro with product/infra to tune autoscale thresholds and fallback routing percentage. putting action items in the incident doc.

priya: will add p95/p99 heatmaps and sidecar metrics to the incident doc.

jamie: propose automated short-circuit to fallback at 20% if p99 crosses threshold for 3m next time.

alex: noted. closing thread.
